investigation_a_implicit_authority.observed_condition: PR #157 contained helpers with defaults resembling grants=None, implicit AdmissionSelection(all_selected=True), fixed 'local-user' principal, and entry points manufacturing permissive admission services on missing authority.
investigation_a_implicit_authority.root_cause: src/repo_catalog/domain/context_admission.py:create_local_admission_service defaulted grants=None, all_selected=True; LocalAuthorizationPolicy allowed all dependency grants when grants was None; ProviderAcquisition._open_context and PairedAcquisitionCoordinator manufactured permissive admission services when auth/admission was omitted.
investigation_a_implicit_authority.remediation: Enforced fail-closed behavior across ProviderAcquisition and PairedAcquisitionCoordinator when authorization/admission is omitted (raising AdmissionRefused('PERMISSION_DENIED')). Require explicit selection and grants in create_local_admission_service with credential authentication. Enforced principal matching and finite grant subset validation in LocalAuthorizationPolicy.
